title: Answer: time is a sequence of ontic steps, to be derived

statements.text: Conscious time is a sequence of ontic steps whose short quantum buffer builds a moment of experience, with classical memory carrying the past. In Faggin’s picture time is not fundamental: units exist before it, and time must be derived from their nature.

sources.quote: The quantum memory intrinsic in the ontic evolution instead works well as a short-term buffer to build up a fuller experience

sources.locator: section 'The Scientific Study of Inner Reality'
sources.quote: we must then explain the concepts of space, time, matter, and energy—so far held to be fundamental—with new primitive concepts
